"This module only affects apps that support FCM push (apps declaring an FCM receive receiver); other apps are never affected.
System apps that support FCM are always exempt and do not appear in this list.
The two lists are independent.
Changes take effect immediately. System power consumption may increase when this module is enabled."
Enable this module in LSPosed, then reopen this page. Settings cannot be changed until the service is available.
When off, the module icon is hidden from the launcher; settings are still available from LSPosed Manager
"Remove HyperOS's restrictions on FCM connection-related broadcasts. System power consumption may increase when this module is enabled."
